title: [SOA] Keep setup buffer current after instruction sync (AB#660003)
summary: The SOA Setup timestamp helper now saves through the caller's buffer instead of a separate record, ensuring the row version stays current and preventing stale-record errors during scheduling.
key_points: Timestamp helper for Instructions Last Sync At now saves through the caller's SOA Setup buffer instead of a separate record
Keeps the caller's row version current so the later Modify in ScheduleSOAgent should not fail with stale-record error 85132286
Avoids the error handler rescheduling instead of completing normal end-of-run bookkeeping
Missing-record check, scheduling, recovery and the 30-minute refresh interval are unchanged
Runtime reproduction and regression tests are still pending
